proposal.summary: A privacy issue in macOS was addressed with improved private data redaction for log entries; an app may be able to read sensitive location information. The issue is fixed in macOS Ventura 13.5.
proposal.affected_product: macOS Ventura (fixed in 13.5; earlier versions affected)
proposal.cwe_quote: An app may be able to read sensitive location information.

AV.quote: An app may be able to read sensitive location information.

C.quote: An app may be able to read sensitive location information.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request reproduction details and technical root-cause from the reporter/vendor (how an app reads location from logs), and confirm the exact affected macOS Ventura build range prior to 13.5 so users can be notified and mitigations provided.

evidence_quotes.quote: This issue is fixed in macOS Ventura 13.5.
A privacy issue was addressed with improved private data redaction for log entries.
An app may be able to read sensitive location information.
